correctness.rationale: The binary greedy-arch index equals number of shortest prefixes containing 0 and 1. The one-sided forbidden contiguous factor 1^(r+1) is tracked with E_j,Z,O_j states and one-run length j<=r; eliminating states gives exactly F_r(z,u)=(1+z-z^(r+1)-u z^(r+2))/(1-z-2u z²+u z^(r+2)+u² z^(r+3)). The constant-universality layer is 1 empty, 1+1_(n<=r) for n>=1. Minimal j-universal length=2j, with k+1 witnesses for r=1 and 2^k for r>=2. Simple dominant root at u=1 gives mu_r via Q_u/(rho Q_z) for fixed r; rho_r is the unique root Σ_{j=1}^{r+1}rho^j=1, and mu_r->1/3. Independently brute-enumerated all legal strings up to n=10 for r=1..5, checked literal subsequence index and coefficient recurrence; C PASS for all fixed integer r>=1 by finite-state and analytic proof.
